page: Polingual: language learning for multilingual learners
Polingual teaches one word across many languages and scripts. Hear every word said, see its roots, and keep a daily streak. For iPhone and iPad.
, with word tiles in French, Hebrew, Greek, Arabic, Hindi and Chinese
Polingual word tiles in six scripts
After 100 days, expect to know 280 words across 4 languages, and remember 95% of them.
